messages.text: Can i speak with a support
Handed to the team · Customer asked for a human.

The team has it and someone will jump into this chat — they're on right now. Stay here if you can; otherwise they'll confirm by email, usually within one business day.

Anything I can start on meanwhile?

Understood — it's already with them and marked urgent, and they're on right now, so keep this window open.

If you tell me what it's about, I can get moving on it while you wait.
Irritating how — the noise, or is one already running for you?

You're right, it changed. BitFortun's firmware was reporting a hashrate the unit didn't actually hit, so we corrected the listing to the true figure — 18 TH/s at ~300 W, $599.99. Rather than leave the old number up.

It's also off sale right now until that firmware fix lands. Want me to show you what's buyable today instead?

The ones on the page right now are the corrected ones: 18 TH/s, ~300 W at the wall, ~50 dB, water-cooled, four BM1373 chips, $599.99. That's what the unit actually does.

At 10¢/kWh that's about $16 a month in power. What do you pay per kWh?
